researcher_notes: Sweep order: energycapitalhtx.com (by far the most productive single source for dated 2025-2026 Houston energy funding, M&A and leadership news), InnovationMap, Greentown Labs and Halliburton Labs cohort pages, HBJ/KHOU fastest-growing coverage, then direct curl of each company's /contact, /about and /leadership pages, then public LinkedIn company pages for employee bands. No browser sessions were used. What was thin: (1) minerals/royalty and midstream developers - the Houston names in that band either have Wix/JS sites with no readable contact data (Fortis Minerals) or were acquired mid-2025/2026 (Ridgemar to Crescent, Momentum Midstream to Williams, WildFire to Magnolia), so both categories are under-represented here; (2) named executive emails - not one of the 28 companies publishes a personal email address, so contact_email is null across the board and only general info@/hello@ addresses were recorded; (3) employee counts - for private companies the only published figure is the LinkedIn company-page band, cited as employee_count_source; five rows (Ignis, Collide, Epsilon, Riley, Ryder Scott) could not be sourced at all and are null. Verifier flags: seven rows carry a LinkedIn band of 51-200 (Utility Global, Plus Power, Amperon, Battalion Oil, Enventure, Pickering Energy Partners, Chariot Energy) whose upper bound exceeds the 150-employee ceiling - these need a headcount confirmation before outreach. Two rows are thin on contact data because the company site was unreachable during the pull (Gold H2 502, NESA Energy 502/500). Plus Power's LinkedIn page lists a San Francisco HQ while its own contact page publishes only The Woodlands, TX. Helix Earth's contact page shows a (832) 222-2222 number that reads as a placeholder, so it was not recorded. Seven rows use trigger_signal 'other' honestly because no dated 2025-2026 event could be found (Tachyus, Data Gumbo, Battalion Oil, Pickering, ADI Analytics) or because the dated event is a commercial/technical milestone rather than one of the listed categories (Syzygy, Cemvita, Gold H2, Collide, Riley). No revenue figures were sourced for any row, so revenue_estimate is null throughout.
